Container.Name: tts-pronunciation-proxy
Container.Overview: Pronunciation proxy for an OpenAI-compatible TTS server (e.g. Kokoro-FastAPI). Sits in front of the TTS and respells known-mispronounced words (sonarr -> sonar) in the request before forwarding; a transparent reverse proxy for every other endpoint, streaming audio straight back. Point TTS clients at this instead of the raw server, and manage the respelling list in the built-in web UI at /pronunciation/. The raw TTS stays reachable for direct use.

Config.Name: Web UI / API Port
Config.Description: Service port. Point TTS clients here; the management UI is at /pronunciation/

Config.Name: Upstream TTS URL
Config.Description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible TTS server this forwards to (e.g. Kokoro-FastAPI)

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Log verbosity: error / warn / info / debug
